This allows XSS if the DB error contains user-controlled data. Additionally, locals=locals exposes Python built-ins and local variables to the template.

render_template_string in the 404 error handler passes locals=locals as a template argument. This exposes all local Python variables and built-in functions (dir, help, __builtins__) to the Jinja2 template renderer, enabling potential server-side template injection or information disclosure.

render_template_string in the search error handler passes locals=locals as a template argument, exposing Python built-ins and local variables to the template. Additionally, str(e) (exception message) is interpolated into the HTML via % formatting without sanitization.
